name: Eastham
summary: Eastham is a coastal Aluvian town on the road from Arwic to Rithwic and the closest human settlement to Asheron's Island, reached through a permanent portal by the windmill; the Aluvian master smith crafts Celdon armour here and a master mask-crafter lives in town. The town is a cluster of Aluvian halls around a square (z 20) with a well, the Banderling statue on its plinth, the Town Network portal and the Patriarch's Valley portal; 230 m east a stone windmill with east-facing turning sails stands on the meadow with the Life Stone and Asheron's Island portal at its foot, and beyond it the land falls to a wide grey-sand beach and the shallow sea.

landmarks.name: Windmill
landmarks.note: Octagon tower top 33.8; 18 m sails on the east face (blade box z 22.8-40.7).

landmarks.name: Nullified Statue of a Banderling
landmarks.note: On a 6.8 m plinth (S110) in the square, Fireworks Generator.

landmarks.name: The Leaping Stallion inn S105
landmarks.note: Brick hall west of the square.

landmarks.name: Beach and shallow sea
landmarks.note: Grey sand (type 11) and WaterShallowSea (type 18) north-east of the windmill.

shots.standingOrder: Fly in level from the shallow sea toward the Eastham shore with the windmill dead ahead and the town beyond; hold 20 m above the water.
shots.notes: Water opener: level 22 m above the shallow sea NE of town, flying 98 m SW toward the coast with the windmill dead ahead (NDC 0.04,0.34) and Eastham's roofs beyond; morning sun behind the camera lights the shore. All over water/beach (terrain types WaterShallowSea and SandGrey), nothing within 28 m.

shots.standingOrder: Hold a locked-off frame on the windmill with its sails turning, the Life Stone and Asheron's Island portal glowing at its foot; do not move.
shots.notes: Locked-off static (motion lives inside the frame): the windmill's east-facing sails turn against the morning sky, Asheron's Island portal swirls at its foot (NDC -0.05,-0.33) and the Life Stone sparkles at left (NDC -0.76,-0.33). Camera 52 m SSE at 1.8 m above the meadow. Clearance 12.4 m (default bake) and 6.5 m (opt-in retail bake); query-radius 4 m = 0.

shots.standingOrder: Hold on the windmill from the shore road, then whip right across the meadow onto the rooftops of Eastham and hold; stay on the road, do not move the camera.
shots.notes: Whip-pan: from the shore road (2.3 m up) the frame holds the windmill silhouetted against the low eastern sun, then whips 178 deg right in 0.3 s at 45 % onto the sunlit rooftops of Eastham 158 m west and holds. No obstacle within 22 m.

shots.standingOrder: Hold behind the Banderling statue's plinth with the Town Network portal hidden, then truck right until its blue swirl and the square open up beyond; stay 5 m from the plinth.
shots.notes: Reveal: starts 12 m behind the Banderling statue's 6.8 m plinth with the Town Network portal 44 m beyond completely hidden (25/53 samples blocked by design), holds, then trucks 12 m right until the blue swirl, the well and the square open up. Clearance: 3.5 m from the well (2.7 m-tall setup), 5 m from the nearest NPC, >= 6.8 m from the plinth; vmax 3.1 m/s.

shots.standingOrder: Orbit slowly high around the Eastham square while the clouds race and the morning light swings across the roofs; keep 15 m above every roof and tree.
shots.notes: Hyperlapse closer: 0.22 turn counter-clockwise around the town square at radius 68 m, 34 m up (>= 21 m above every roof), while the sky clock runs 110x (0.23 game-day: sun 0.30 -> 0.53, always up) so clouds race and the light swings across the roofs. vmax 5.9 m/s.
